questfn1-families#94.en: that is why roots and x-intercepts are the same thing
questfn1-families#94.af: daarom is wortels en x-afsnitte dieselfde ding

questfn1-families#95.en: Each answer is a point: (the x you got ; 0)
questfn1-families#95.af: Elke antwoord is 'n punt: (die x wat jy kry ; 0)

questfn1-families#96.en: f(3) substitutes x = 3 and gives back the y-value. y-intercept: let x = 0. x-intercepts: let y = 0.
questfn1-families#96.af: f(3) vervang x = 3 en gee die y-waarde terug. y-afsnit: stel x = 0. x-afsnitte: stel y = 0.

questfn2-line-parabola#7.en: In y = ax + q the gradient is a. a > 0 → up, a < 0 → down.
questfn2-line-parabola#7.af: In y = ax + q is die gradiënt a. a > 0 → op, a < 0 → af.

questfn2-line-parabola#9.en: Compare with y = ax + q: here a = ${C(cv.a)}
questfn2-line-parabola#9.af: Vergelyk met y = ax + q: hier is a = ${C(cv.a)}

questfn2-line-parabola#10.en: a is the gradient, q is the y-intercept
questfn2-line-parabola#10.af: a is die gradiënt, q is die y-afsnit

questfn2-line-parabola#11.en: a is ${inc ? "positive" : "negative"}, and it is the gradient that decides the direction
questfn2-line-parabola#11.af: a is ${inc ? "positief" : "negatief"}, en dit is die gradiënt wat die rigting bepaal

questfn2-line-parabola#12.en: a > 0 climbs left to right, a < 0 falls
questfn2-line-parabola#12.af: a > 0 klim van links na regs, a < 0 val

questfn2-line-parabola#13.en: ∴ the line is ${inc ? "increasing — it slopes up" : "decreasing — it slopes down"}
questfn2-line-parabola#13.af: ∴ die lyn is ${inc ? "stygend: dit loop op" : "dalend: dit loop af"}

questfn2-line-parabola#15.en: x-intercept: let y = 0 and solve for x.
questfn2-line-parabola#15.af: x-afsnit: stel y = 0 en los op vir x.

questfn2-line-parabola#17.en: The x-axis is the line y = 0, so put y = 0 into ${eqStr(cv, "f(x)")}
questfn2-line-parabola#17.af: Die x-as is die lyn y = 0, dus vervang y = 0 in ${eqStr(cv, "f(x)")}

questfn2-line-parabola#20.en: write it as a point, with a semicolon
questfn2-line-parabola#20.af: skryf dit as 'n punt, met 'n kommapunt

questfn2-line-parabola#22.en: y-intercept: let x = 0. For y = ax + q that is just q.
questfn2-line-parabola#22.af: y-afsnit: stel x = 0. Vir y = ax + q is dit net q.

questfn2-line-parabola#24.en: The y-axis is the line x = 0, so put x = 0 into ${eqStr(cv, "f(x)")}
questfn2-line-parabola#24.af: Die y-as is die lyn x = 0, dus vervang x = 0 in ${eqStr(cv, "f(x)")}

questfn2-line-parabola#28.en: in y = ax + q the y-intercept is always just q
questfn2-line-parabola#28.af: in y = ax + q is die y-afsnit altyd net q

questfn2-line-parabola#34.en: a > 0 → opens up (minimum); a < 0 → opens down (maximum).
questfn2-line-parabola#34.af: a > 0 → oop na bo (minimum); a < 0 → oop na onder (maksimum).

questfn2-line-parabola#36.en: Only one number decides the shape: a, the number in front of x². Here a = ${C(paraStd(cv).a)}
questfn2-line-parabola#36.af: Net een getal besluit die vorm: a, die getal voor x². Hier is a = ${C(paraStd(cv).a)}

questfn2-line-parabola#37.en: a is ${happy ? "positive, so the arms point UP" : "negative, so the arms point DOWN"}
questfn2-line-parabola#37.af: a is ${happy ? "positief, dus wys die arms OP" : "negatief, dus wys die arms AF"}
nested: positive, so the arms point UP
negative, so the arms point DOWN

questfn2-line-parabola#38.en: a happy parabola, and its turning point is the LOWEST point → a minimum
questfn2-line-parabola#38.af: 'n happy parabool, en sy draaipunt is die LAAGSTE punt → 'n minimum

questfn2-line-parabola#39.en: a sad parabola, and its turning point is the HIGHEST point → a maximum
questfn2-line-parabola#39.af: 'n sad parabool, en sy draaipunt is die HOOGSTE punt → 'n maksimum

questfn2-line-parabola#41.en: x of the turning point = −b/(2a); substitute it back to get the y-value.
questfn2-line-parabola#41.af: x van die draaipunt = −b/(2a); vervang dit terug om die y-waarde te kry.

questfn2-line-parabola#43.en: Read off the standard form y = ax² + bx + c: a = ${C(st.a)}, b = ${C(st.b)}, c = ${C(st.c)}
questfn2-line-parabola#43.af: Lees die standaardvorm y = ax² + bx + c af: a = ${C(st.a)}, b = ${C(st.b)}, c = ${C(st.c)}

questfn2-line-parabola#46.en: Substitute that x back into f: f(${C(tp.x)}) = ${C(tp.y)}
questfn2-line-parabola#46.af: Vervang daardie x terug in f: f(${C(tp.x)}) = ${C(tp.y)}

questfn2-line-parabola#48.en: ${paraTPString(cv)} is in turning-point form. What is its turning point?
questfn2-line-parabola#48.af: ${paraTPString(cv)} is in draaipunt-vorm. Wat is sy draaipunt?

questfn2-line-parabola#49.en: In y = a(x − p)² + q the turning point is (p ; q) — the sign inside the bracket flips: (x − 2)² turns at x = +2, (x + 2)² at x = −2.
questfn2-line-parabola#49.af: In y = a(x − p)² + q is die draaipunt (p ; q), en die teken binne die hakie draai om: (x − 2)² draai by x = +2, (x + 2)² by x = −2.

questfn2-line-parabola#51.en: Compare with y = a(x − p)² + q
questfn2-line-parabola#51.af: Vergelyk met y = a(x − p)² + q

questfn2-line-parabola#52.af: Die hakie lees (x ${p > 0 ? "−" : "+"} ${C(Math.abs(p))}), dus is p = ${C(p)}

questfn2-line-parabola#53.en: OPPOSITE sign to what you see inside the bracket
questfn2-line-parabola#53.af: TEENOORGESTELDE teken van wat jy binne die hakie sien

questfn2-line-parabola#54.en: The number sitting outside the bracket is q = ${C(q)}
questfn2-line-parabola#54.af: Die getal buite die hakie is q = ${C(q)}

questfn2-line-parabola#55.en: that one keeps its own sign
questfn2-line-parabola#55.af: daardie een hou sy eie teken

questfn2-line-parabola#57.en: What is the axis of symmetry of ${eqStr(cv, "f(x)")}?

questfn2-line-parabola#63.en: The axis of symmetry is the vertical line through the turning point: x = (the x of the TP).
questfn2-line-parabola#63.af: Die simmetrie-as is die vertikale lyn deur die draaipunt: x = (die x van die DP).

questfn2-line-parabola#65.en: The axis of symmetry is the vertical line the parabola folds onto — it runs through the turning point
questfn2-line-parabola#65.af: Die simmetrie-as is die vertikale lyn waarop die parabool vou: dit loop deur die draaipunt

questfn2-line-parabola#66.en: So all you need is the x of the TP: x = −b/(2a) = −(${C(st.b)})/(2(${C(st.a)})) = ${C(tp.x)}
questfn2-line-parabola#66.af: Al wat jy dus nodig het, is die x van die DP: x = −b/(2a) = −(${C(st.b)})/(2(${C(st.a)})) = ${C(tp.x)}

questfn2-line-parabola#67.en: a vertical line is written x = …, never y = …
questfn2-line-parabola#67.af: 'n vertikale lyn word as x = … geskryf, nooit as y = … nie

questfn2-line-parabola#74.en: Range = the y-values covered. A happy parabola starts at its minimum y and goes up (y ≥ min); a sad one (y ≤ max).
questfn2-line-parabola#74.af: Waardeversameling = die y-waardes wat gedek word. 'n happy parabool begin by sy minimum y en gaan op (y ≥ min); 'n sad een (y ≤ maks).

questfn2-line-parabola#76.en: Range means: which y-values does the graph actually reach? So find the turning point first
questfn2-line-parabola#76.af: Waardeversameling beteken: watter y-waardes bereik die grafiek werklik? Kry dus eers die draaipunt

questfn2-line-parabola#77.en: x = −b/(2a) = ${C(tp.x)}, and putting that back in gives y = ${C(tp.y)}
questfn2-line-parabola#77.af: x = −b/(2a) = ${C(tp.x)}, en as jy dit terugvervang, kry jy y = ${C(tp.y)}

questfn2-line-parabola#78.en: a = ${C(a)} is ${a > 0 ? `positive → happy, so ${C(tp.y)} is the LOWEST y and the arms climb from there` : `negative → sad, so ${C(tp.y)} is the HIGHEST y and the arms fall away`}
questfn2-line-parabola#78.af: a = ${C(a)} is ${a > 0 ? `positief → happy, dus is ${C(tp.y)} die LAAGSTE y en die arms klim van daar af op` : `negatief → sad, dus is ${C(tp.y)} die HOOGSTE y en die arms val weg`}
nested: positive → happy, so ${C(tp.y)} is the LOWEST y and the arms climb from there
negative → sad, so ${C(tp.y)} is the HIGHEST y and the arms fall away

questfn2-line-parabola#79.en: the turning point y is included, so it is ≥ / ≤, not > / <
questfn2-line-parabola#79.af: die y van die draaipunt is ingesluit, dus is dit ≥ / ≤, nie > / < nie

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#6.en: For y = a/(x − p) + q the vertical asymptote is x = p and the horizontal asymptote is y = q.
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#6.af: Vir y = a/(x − p) + q is die vertikale asimptoot x = p en die horisontale asimptoot y = q.

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#8.en: Compare with y = a/(x − p) + q: here p = ${C(cv.p)} and q = ${C(cv.q)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#8.af: Vergelyk met y = a/(x − p) + q: hier is p = ${C(cv.p)} en q = ${C(cv.q)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#9.en: The denominator is just x, and you cannot divide by 0, so x = 0 is forbidden
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#9.af: Die noemer is net x, en jy kan nie deur 0 deel nie, dus is x = 0 verbode

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#10.en: The denominator is 0 when x ${cv.p < 0 ? "+" : "−"} ${C(Math.abs(cv.p))} = 0, i.e. x = ${C(cv.p)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#10.af: Die noemer is 0 wanneer x ${cv.p < 0 ? "+" : "−"} ${C(Math.abs(cv.p))} = 0, d.w.s. x = ${C(cv.p)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#11.en: that forbidden x is the VERTICAL asymptote
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#11.af: daardie verbode x is die VERTIKALE asimptoot

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#12.en: The fraction can shrink towards 0 but never reaches it, so y never quite reaches ${C(cv.q)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#12.af: Die breuk kan na 0 toe krimp, maar bereik dit nooit nie, dus bereik y nooit heeltemal ${C(cv.q)} nie

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#19.en: The graph exists for every x except at the vertical asymptote x = p.
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#19.af: Die grafiek bestaan vir elke x behalwe by die vertikale asimptoot x = p.

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#20.en: Domain asks: which x-values am I allowed to put in?
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#20.af: Definisieversameling vra: watter x-waardes mag ek insit?

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#21.en: Only one x breaks the formula — the one that makes the denominator 0, x = ${C(cv.p)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#21.af: Net een x breek die formule: die een wat die noemer 0 maak, x = ${C(cv.p)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#22.af: jy kan nie deur 0 deel nie

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#24.en: the restriction rides after a semicolon

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#29.en: The y-values cover everything except the horizontal asymptote y = q.
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#29.af: Die y-waardes dek alles behalwe die horisontale asimptoot y = q.

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#30.en: Range asks: which y-values does the graph actually reach?
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#30.af: Waardeversameling vra: watter y-waardes bereik die grafiek werklik?

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#31.en: In y = a/(x − p) + q the fraction part can get tiny, but it can never be exactly 0
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#31.af: In y = a/(x − p) + q kan die breukdeel baie klein word, maar dit kan nooit presies 0 wees nie

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#32.en: So y can never be exactly ${C(cv.q)}, but it reaches everything else
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#32.af: Dus kan y nooit presies ${C(cv.q)} wees nie, maar dit bereik alles anders

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#38.en: a > 0 → the branches sit top-right & bottom-left and each one decreases; a < 0 → top-left & bottom-right, each increases.
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#38.af: a > 0 → die vlerkies sit regs bo & links onder en elkeen daal; a < 0 → links bo & regs onder, elkeen styg.

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#39.en: a = ${C(cv.a)} ${dec ? "> 0 → decreasing" : "< 0 → increasing"} on each branch.
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#39.af: a = ${C(cv.a)}, ${dec ? "dus a > 0 → dalend" : "dus a < 0 → stygend"} op elke vlerkie.

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#40.en: In y = a/(x − p) + q it is a that places the branches. Here a = ${C(cv.a)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#40.af: In y = a/(x − p) + q is dit a wat die vlerkies plaas. Hier is a = ${C(cv.a)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#41.en: a is ${dec ? "positive, so the branches sit top-right and bottom-left" : "negative, so the branches sit top-left and bottom-right"}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#41.af: a is ${dec ? "positief, dus sit die vlerkies regs bo en links onder" : "negatief, dus sit die vlerkies links bo en regs onder"}
nested: positive, so the branches sit top-right and bottom-left
negative, so the branches sit top-left and bottom-right

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#42.en: Trace one branch from left to right: it ${dec ? "falls" : "climbs"} the whole way
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#42.af: Volg een vlerkie van links na regs: dit ${dec ? "daal" : "klim"} die hele pad

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#43.en: ∴ each branch is ${dec ? "decreasing" : "increasing"} — say it per branch, never “the graph”
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#43.af: ∴ elke vlerkie is ${dec ? "dalend" : "stygend"}: sê dit per vlerkie, nooit “die grafiek” nie

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#47.af: Nie een nie: dis 'n reguit lyn

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#49.en: Aeroplane idea: b > 1 takes off (growth); 0 < b < 1 lands (decay).
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#49.af: Vliegtuig-idee: b > 1 styg op (groei); 0 < b < 1 land (verval).

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#51.en: b is the base — the number carrying the x. Here b = ${C(cv.b)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#51.af: b is die grondtal: die getal wat die x dra. Hier is b = ${C(cv.b)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#52.en: b > 1, so every step to the right multiplies the y-value by more than 1 and it climbs
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#52.af: b > 1, dus vermenigvuldig elke tree na regs die y-waarde met meer as 1 en dit klim

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#53.en: 0 < b < 1, so every step to the right multiplies the y-value by less than 1 and it shrinks
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#53.af: 0 < b < 1, dus vermenigvuldig elke tree na regs die y-waarde met minder as 1 en dit krimp

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#54.en: growth — the graph is taking off

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#62.en: In y = a·bˣ + q the graph flattens towards the horizontal line y = q.
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#62.af: In y = a·bˣ + q plat die grafiek af na die horisontale lyn y = q.

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#64.en: Compare with y = a·b^(x − p) + q: here q = ${C(cv.q)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#64.af: Vergelyk met y = a·b^(x − p) + q: hier is q = ${C(cv.q)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#65.en: On one side the power term shrinks towards 0, but a power of a positive base is never actually 0
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#65.af: Aan een kant krimp die magsterm na 0 toe, maar 'n mag van 'n positiewe grondtal is nooit werklik 0 nie

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#66.en: So y creeps towards ${C(cv.q)} + 0 and flattens out just short of it
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#66.af: Dus kruip y na ${C(cv.q)} + 0 toe en plat net kort daarvan af

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#67.en: ∴ the asymptote is y = ${C(cv.q)} — horizontal, so it is y = …
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#67.af: ∴ die asimptoot is y = ${C(cv.q)}: horisontaal, dus is dit y = …

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#71.en: The graph sits entirely on one side of its asymptote y = q. a > 0 → above (y > q); a < 0 → below (y < q).
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#71.af: Die grafiek lê heeltemal aan een kant van sy asimptoot y = q. a > 0 → bo (y > q); a < 0 → onder (y < q).

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#72.en: Start at the asymptote: q = ${C(cv.q)}, so the graph flattens onto y = ${C(cv.q)}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#72.af: Begin by die asimptoot: q = ${C(cv.q)}, dus plat die grafiek af na y = ${C(cv.q)}

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#73.en: a = ${C(cv.a)} says which side it lives on: ${above ? "a is positive, so the whole graph sits ABOVE the asymptote" : "a is negative, so the whole graph sits BELOW the asymptote"}
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#73.af: a = ${C(cv.a)} sê aan watter kant dit lê: ${above ? "a is positief, dus lê die hele grafiek BO die asimptoot" : "a is negatief, dus lê die hele grafiek ONDER die asimptoot"}
nested: a is positive, so the whole graph sits ABOVE the asymptote
a is negative, so the whole graph sits BELOW the asymptote

questfn3-hyperbola-exp#74.en: It gets as close as you like but never lands on it
questfn3-hyperbola-exp#74.af: Dit kom so naby as wat jy wil, maar land nooit daarop nie

questfn4-read-graph#1.af: Lees die y-afsnit van die grafiek af.

questfn4-read-graph#2.en: The y-intercept is where the graph crosses the y-axis (x = 0). Follow the dashed line.
questfn4-read-graph#2.af: Die y-afsnit is waar die grafiek die y-as sny (x = 0). Volg die stippellyn.

questfn4-read-graph#4.en: The y-intercept is where the curve crosses the y-axis, and every point on that axis has x = 0
questfn4-read-graph#4.af: Die y-afsnit is waar die kurwe die y-as sny, en elke punt op daardie as het x = 0

questfn4-read-graph#5.en: Follow the dashed line from the marked point across to the y-axis: it lands on ${C(yi)}
questfn4-read-graph#5.af: Volg die stippellyn van die gemerkte punt oor na die y-as: dit land op ${C(yi)}

questfn4-read-graph#7.en: x first, then y, with a semicolon between them
questfn4-read-graph#7.af: eers x, dan y, met 'n kommapunt tussen hulle

questfn4-read-graph#8.af: Lees die x-afsnit van die grafiek af.

questfn4-read-graph#9.en: The x-intercept is where the graph crosses the x-axis (y = 0).
questfn4-read-graph#9.af: Die x-afsnit is waar die grafiek die x-as sny (y = 0).

questfn4-read-graph#11.en: The x-intercept is where the line cuts the x-axis, and every point on that axis has y = 0
questfn4-read-graph#11.af: Die x-afsnit is waar die lyn die x-as sny, en elke punt op daardie as het y = 0

questfn4-read-graph#12.en: Drop the dashed line from the marked point down to the x-axis: it lands on ${C(xi)}
questfn4-read-graph#12.af: Volg die stippellyn van die gemerkte punt af na die x-as: dit land op ${C(xi)}

questfn4-read-graph#14.en: the 0 goes SECOND here — it is the y-coordinate
questfn4-read-graph#14.af: die 0 kom hier TWEEDE: dit is die y-koördinaat

questfn4-read-graph#15.en: Read the turning point off the graph.
questfn4-read-graph#15.af: Lees die draaipunt van die grafiek af.

questfn4-read-graph#16.en: The turning point is the lowest (or highest) point of the parabola. Read the dashed lines to both axes.
questfn4-read-graph#16.af: Die draaipunt is die laagste (of hoogste) punt van die parabool. Lees die stippellyne na albei asse.

questfn4-read-graph#18.en: The turning point is where the parabola stops and comes back — the ${paraStd(cv).a > 0 ? "lowest" : "highest"} point of the curve
questfn4-read-graph#18.af: Die draaipunt is waar die parabool stop en terugdraai: die ${paraStd(cv).a > 0 ? "laagste" : "hoogste"} punt van die kurwe

questfn4-read-graph#19.en: a is ${paraStd(cv).a > 0 ? "positive → happy, so it is a minimum" : "negative → sad, so it is a maximum"}
questfn4-read-graph#19.af: a is ${paraStd(cv).a > 0 ? "positief → happy, dus is dit 'n minimum" : "negatief → sad, dus is dit 'n maksimum"}
nested: positive → happy, so it is a minimum
negative → sad, so it is a maximum

questfn4-read-graph#20.en: Follow the dashed line DOWN to the x-axis: x = ${C(tp.x)}
questfn4-read-graph#20.af: Volg die stippellyn AF na die x-as: x = ${C(tp.x)}

questfn4-read-graph#21.en: Follow the dashed line ACROSS to the y-axis: y = ${C(tp.y)}
questfn4-read-graph#21.af: Volg die stippellyn OOR na die y-as: y = ${C(tp.y)}

questfn4-read-graph#23.en: Read the asymptotes off the graph (the dashed lines).
questfn4-read-graph#23.af: Lees die asimptote van die grafiek af (die stippellyne).

questfn4-read-graph#28.en: The vertical dashed line is x = …; the horizontal dashed line is y = ….
questfn4-read-graph#28.af: Die vertikale stippellyn is x = …; die horisontale stippellyn is y = ….

questfn4-read-graph#30.en: A hyperbola has two dashed lines: one standing up, one lying flat
questfn4-read-graph#30.af: 'n Hiperbool het twee stippellyne: een wat regop staan, een wat plat lê

questfn4-read-graph#31.en: The upright one crosses the x-axis at ${C(cv.p)}, and an upright line is written x = …
questfn4-read-graph#31.af: Die regop een sny die x-as by ${C(cv.p)}, en 'n regop lyn word geskryf as x = …

questfn4-read-graph#33.en: The flat one crosses the y-axis at ${C(cv.q)}, and a flat line is written y = …
questfn4-read-graph#33.af: Die plat een sny die y-as by ${C(cv.q)}, en 'n plat lyn word geskryf as y = …

questfn4-read-graph#35.en: Read the asymptote off the graph (the dashed line).
questfn4-read-graph#35.af: Lees die asimptoot van die grafiek af (die stippellyn).

questfn4-read-graph#40.en: An exponential graph flattens towards one horizontal dashed line, y = ….
